members.name: squeeze_release_breakout_001
members.thesis: This strategy exploits volatility expansion after intraday compression resolves with direction and volume. The inefficiency exists because traders reduce risk during compression and then chase once the move is obvious, and it persists because many breakouts fail without participation, so timing and
filters: prefer trades aligned with NIFTY50 VWAP direction
weaknesses: Performance is regime-dependent and weakens materially when session structure changes mid-trade.
Fast moves can create worse-than-assumed slippage and reduce realized edge versus paper assumptions.
Crowding risk can compress payoff and make execution quality unstable in the most obvious setups.
members.prior_art: TTM-style squeeze breakout adapted to 1-minute equities

members.name: vwap_pinch_breakout
members.thesis: Exploits a 'volatility squeeze' between two anchors of price. When the 1-min 20 EMA and VWAP converge (the 'pinch'), it indicates a balance of power. The breakout from this range typically carries institutional force as one side gives up. This is an information-based inefficiency.
weaknesses: Requires liquid stocks to avoid gap slippage
